title: L1 ordinary without archive
rationale: Ordinary change does not require archives or separation.

title: L2 saved but retrieval unexecuted
rationale: Save and verification are distinct.

title: SHA mismatch
rationale: Observed mismatch cannot be accepted.

title: CRC corruption
rationale: ZIP corruption is a demonstrated contradiction.

title: Manifest unavailable
rationale: Missing required manifest blocks ZIP verification.

title: SOLO same owner separated verification
rationale: Technical PASS does not claim human independence.

title: Workspace copy
rationale: A workspace copy cannot substitute direct storage retrieval.

title: Confidential L1
rationale: Known confidential risk requires Level 3.

title: Expired approval
rationale: Expired authorization cannot be reused.

title: Case-specific approval scope mismatch
rationale: A different case does not inherit approval.

title: ACL insufficient
rationale: Insufficient required access blocks custody, not unrelated documentation.

title: Original location unknown
rationale: Unknown is not absence and cannot pass original identity.

title: Regenerated substitute
rationale: Regenerated bytes do not recover historical original.

title: Technical PASS claimed third party
rationale: SOLO limitations cannot be rewritten to independent human PASS.

title: Past BLOCKED overwritten
rationale: Old decisions must remain immutable history.

title: Bundle restore omitted
rationale: Level 2 cannot waive recovery acceptance purpose.

title: L1 required CI failed
rationale: Lower custody burden does not weaken required CI.

title: L1 review unexecuted
rationale: Review is separate from preservation applicability.

title: L3 STRICT all observed
rationale: Explicit strict evidence and all mandatory checks permit hypothetical acceptance.

title: STRICT human identity unknown
rationale: Unknown human independence remains unknown.

title: STRICT same owner
rationale: Strict mode cannot silently become SOLO.

title: SOLO same session
rationale: Separate session is a SOLO technical condition.

title: SOLO execution reused
rationale: One execution relabeled B is not distinct verification.

title: SOLO workspace reused
rationale: Verification must use separate area.

title: Producer report only
rationale: Producer log cannot substitute bytes.

title: Missing receipt
rationale: Custody receipt is mandatory and not inferred from verification.

title: Storage unreachable
rationale: Unavailable destination cannot yield custody PASS.

title: Retention unknown
rationale: Owner term and storage mechanism are distinct.

title: Policy not adopted
rationale: Design candidate does not authorize actual migration.

title: Post-hoc downgrade
rationale: Cannot lower level to hide failures.

title: Bundle object corruption
rationale: Bundle restore alone does not prove all objects.

title: Archive safety untested
rationale: CRC does not detect unsafe archive names.

title: Level unclassified
rationale: Only safe documentation continues; no transfer or acceptance permit.

title: L1 CI explicitly not required
rationale: Required set fixed beforehand can exclude CI but leaves observed NOT_TESTED.

title: Approved reusable scope matches
rationale: Matching valid scope approval needs no new per-artifact owner form.

title: L2 review failed
rationale: Preservation PASS does not override product/document review FAIL.

title: L2 CI unexecuted
rationale: Required CI remains outstanding.

title: Verification mixed unknown and untested
rationale: Mixed missing observations do not become PASS.

title: SOLO retrieval route unknown
rationale: Unknown route does not prove direct retrieval.

title: Important evidence misclassified L1
rationale: Irreplaceable experiment evidence cannot use ordinary-PR exemption.

title: L3 individual approval absent
rationale: Reusable scope alone does not replace L3 individual approval.

title: Mandatory extra check missing
rationale: Case-specific required checks cannot disappear.

title: Mandatory extra check failed
rationale: Additional contract safety condition remains mandatory.

title: Third party claim identity unverified
rationale: Unknown identity is unproven, not demonstrated false.
